summary: Structural anti-recurrence gate for the bare-fetch 401 class + remediation of the live holes the sweep found. A bare fetch('/api/…') without an auth header is rejected 401 by the keycloak Bearer-only gateway BEFORE identity resolves, so the screen silently falls to seed data. Unit tests mock fetch and never catch it (caught live twice: T-0648 ra-grant-trail, T-0649 fetchEmployees /api/org).
sweep_method: Balanced-paren, comment/string-masked scan of every fetch( in web/src (206 total calls; 191 prod, 15 test). Classified each as authed (authHeaders/devHeaders/buildAuthHeaders/apiHeaders/headers-var-delegate/fetchWithAuthRetry) vs bare.

bare_fetch_sites_found.verdict: GENUINE HOLE — post-login rights screen; sibling call in screen-rights.jsx:134 sends authHeaders. REMEDIATED.
BARE (initial dev user-picker load). REMEDIATED (authHeaders() = {} pre-login in dev, behaviour preserved; removes a copy-able bare pattern).

NOT A HOLE — ALLOWLISTED. Public bootstrap route (src/http/auth.ts:518, no withAuth) that DISCOVERS the auth mode before it is known; importing authHeaders here would create a dev-auth<->auth-mode circular import.
NOT A HOLE — ALLOWLISTED. This file DEFINES fetchWithAuthRetry; buildInit() merges authHeaders(). Canonical wrapper.
NOT A HOLE — ALLOWLISTED. OIDC token/refresh endpoint (external IdP, not /api/*); the request OBTAINS the Bearer so cannot carry one.

gate_how_it_works: Node-backed (temp-file heredoc, like package-json-no-dup-keys.sh). For each non-test web/src file it finds every bare fetch( (masks comments + string/template bodies so a // or ) inside a URL never fools paren-balancing; excludes obj.fetch and fetchWithAuthRetry). A call is AUTHED if its text references authHeaders|devHeaders|buildAuthHeaders|apiHeaders|Authorization|X-Dev-User|x-dev-user|Bearer, OR it delegates headers to a variable and a real helper CALL appears within the 12 masked lines above. Otherwise VIOLATION, UNLESS the URL is a string literal NOT containing /api (legit external), or the file is on the documented auth-infra allowlist (dev-auth.js, keycloak-auth.js, auth-mode.js). Wider than the two incident sites: also catches the split-line `const u='/api/x'; fetch(u)` opaque shape.
gate_self_test_cases: BAD (must flag): bare fetch('/api/x'); split-line opaque fetch(u); delegate-headers with only a COMMENT mentioning Authorization. GOOD (must pass): authHeaders inline; headers-var delegate with authHeaders() above; external https string literal; a *.test.js bare fetch (scope excludes tests).

Plus --self-test PASS (rc=0) and normal run PASS on the remediated tree.
